model.context_rule: official prepare_context over sentence prefixes within each passage_label

cv.upstream_behavior: preserve grouped CV, seed and training-only regularization selection
cv.alpha_selection: upstream RidgeGCVTorch on training data; logspace(-3,3,7); alpha_per_target=false

aggregation: median across all neuroids within each fold, then mean folds
normalization: raw_score divided by official cached ceiling
clipping: official normalized score clipped to [0,1]; also preserve raw and unclipped values
policy: Null fields are acceptance blockers, never defaults. No standardization, PCA or alternate ridge fallback.
